source: California Vehicle Code Division 5 framework (Stats. 1959, Ch. 3 and subsequent enactments); §11711 dealer fraud civil remedy in original form
wound_addressed: No statutory civil remedy tied to dealer's licensed status; common law fraud's scienter and reliance requirements defeated most buyer claims; information asymmetry between dealers and buyers unaddressed
design: Licensed dealer civil liability anchored to dealer's licensed status rather than common law fraud elements; covers fraud, misrepresentation, false promise, and deceit in licensed transactions
gap: Original form provided actual damages only; no treble damages; attorneys' fees not expressly provided
verbatim_capture_status: PENDING — specific session law for original §11711 enactment requires verification
